cues.text: Occupancy, the pipeline, overdue rent, the plan of the mall and what needs your attention, at a glance.
The dashboard is the first page you see. It always shows today's numbers.
Occupancy is the share of the leasable area under an active lease. Click it to open the units and the plan.
The weighted pipeline is the yearly rent of the open deals, weighted by how likely each stage is to sign.
Overdue rent turns red when invoices are past due. It also shows how much was collected this month.
The pipeline shows how many deals are in each stage and their value. Each row opens those leads.
The plan draws the plaza level coloured by status: available, on hold, reserved or leased.
Needs attention lists what to act on today: approvals, holds that end, overdue invoices, expiring documents.
And the latest activity shows who did what, in your language.
